blind.description: An ornate golden nef or ship-shaped tabletop vessel (salt cellar). It consists of an oval ship-like hull resting on an ornate circular pedestal base. The open top is filled with a white granular substance (salt). A small central golden mast with a horizontal yardarm and furled sail rises from the center, flanked by crenellated castle structures at the bow and stern. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and detailed with metallic gold and crystalline white textures.
blind.from_above: An oval or almond-shaped golden rim enclosing a bed of white granular salt, bisected across the middle by a thin golden yardarm/mast.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1 foot tall (roughly one-fifth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1 foot in length.

notes: Footprint is slightly broader than typical catalog proportions, but clearly depicts a nef salt cellar
